reden: Yes. The audit report explicitly flags PhiFactory.signatureClaim for ignoring the chainId in the decoded signed data, enabling cross-chain replay. It describes the same function, same root cause (discarded chainId in `(expiresIn, minter, ref, verifier, artId, chainId, data)`), same attack path (calling signatureClaim directly to reuse a signature across chains), and suggests the same fix direction (validate or inject block.chainid). Fixing the issue as described in the report would fix the vulnerability in the description.
